recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A Flow State Night of Art and Reading", "body": "Chance opened the evening as a special extended edition of Vibe Rant, joined by Gabe, Rachel and newcomer Martin. He explained that Flow State meant reading to each other, reflecting on the text and making art on screen, and he urged listeners at home to grab a pencil or canvas and create along with the show. Chance said the format was inspired by Jim Maiden and S.B. Alger, whose older show worked the same way, and that he wanted it more than one night a week. He added that an audiobook side project for Dylan Saccoccio was nearly finished, which freed him to make more art."}, {"title": "Gabe's Secret Societies Timeline and Color Code", "body": "Gabe described his new video series on a rough history of secret societies, laid out as a timeline with centuries along one axis and countries along the other. He said it ran fifty minutes, his longest video yet, and admitted he had made broad generalizations. Gabe explained that he color coded Gnostics in red and Hermetics in purple, equating science with the Hermetics, and argued that the groups blended around the Industrial Revolution and the World Wars. He said he would probably make addendums to be more impeccable with his words."}, {"title": "Mechanism, Mysticism, and Heaven on Earth", "body": "Chance said his intention was to demystify occult material, connecting it to the sky clock and showing the archons as stations of the sun, so that people no longer needed literal supernaturalism. He cited Wilhelm Reich's Ether, God and Devil, saying the mechanistic and the mystic were two imbalanced sides of one way of thinking, with truth somewhere in the middle. Another participant answered that they loved the mystic side and wanted more mystical experiences, and the conversation settled on the idea that higher realms might exist while this world could still be understood as heaven."}, {"title": "German New Medicine Read Aloud and Discussed", "body": "Rachel read the introduction and first chapter of a book on German New Medicine, a framework that mainstream medicine does not accept. The author presented it as discoveries by Dr. Hammer, and the book claimed that a sudden shock leaves a ring shaped lesion in the brain with a matching response in a particular organ, plus a rule about handedness. Afterward one participant questioned the book's tie between energy medicine and quantum physics but liked the idea that the brain rings echoed the concentric layers of the biofield. Another speaker said the premise matched how emotional experience showed up in the body in sound healing work."}, {"title": "Ancestors, Superstition, and Symbols", "body": "The group traded readings and ideas through the night. Early on, a reader took the room through verses of the Havamal about lies and love, and one participant described lying as a kind of magic. Later, participants argued that old superstitions might have rested on real energetic knowledge, and one questioned the idea of progress from caveman to spaceman. Kayleigh read from Carl Jung's Man and His Symbols, where Jung wrote that dreams reveal the unconscious as symbolic images, and Part 1 ended partway through that reading."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tonight's Vibe Rant is going down Flow State style, where everyone is invited to come on screen, show us their art process, and take turns reading from books or articles of their choosing.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "So this is Vibe Rant as you know, but we're doing a special edition, extended flow state, mostly because I wanted to just do an open show tonight.
